newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea First Bank plunges on Kia woes.
newsitem.headline: Korea First Bank plunges on Kia woes.

text.p: Shares of Korea First Bank, a leading creditor of the troubled Kia Group, plunged in early Wedesday trading, brokers said.
Korea First fell 250 won to 3,250 by 0115 GMT. It briefly touched its daily limit low of 3,220.
Financial shares took the heaviest beating in early trading, with the sub-index for the banking sector plunging 4.27 percent to 346.86 by 0125 GMT.
"Kia's financial problems mean trouble with its banks," said Koh Kyong-bae of Hyundai Securities.
The Kia Group had total loans of 9.54 trillion won at the end of May, of which 5.48 trillion won were borrowed from banks, according to Korea First Bank figures.
Korea First's loans to Kia totalled 814.2 billion won.
